envelope.description: Add bounded native CLI activity streams and candidate parsing

body.title: Add bounded native CLI activity streams and candidate parsing
body.summary: Add opt-in no-wall-clock process mode, incremental UTF-8 stdout observation/backpressure and bounded diagnostics. Claude task sessions use stream-json flags; Codex parses JSONL as received. Normalize allowlisted native metadata and emit complete candidate events without treating draft or acknowledgements as results.
acceptanceChecks: Neither process timeout nor old first-output/raw-stdout watchdog is armed in activity mode; explicit group cancellation remains
Both adapters recognize fixture-verified model/tool events with serial callbacks and per-session identity
8 MiB frame/4 MiB candidate/64 KiB diagnostic bounds and queue backpressure hold; overflow stops explicitly without truncation
Candidate recognition is conservative: Claude complete StructuredOutput input, Codex unambiguous final item or successful-turn fallback; acknowledgements and partial JSON excluded
Existing non-task CLI envelope/schema behavior and timeout handling remain unchanged
Native fixtures identify their actual source/dialect; locally available CLI metadata may be inspected without model calls; no fabricated live-proof claim

tests.name: Claude/Codex fixture streams: incremental UTF-8, partial frames, tool IDs, candidate recognition and conservative final-output fallback
Activity process has no fixed timer/watchdog, explicit cancellation kills group, buffers/queues remain bounded and non-task mode unchanged
